FAQs
Before you ask
What is Colossyan?
Colossyan is an AI platform that turns your existing knowledge into training and enablement content. You bring documents, briefs, or raw expertise. The platform handles video creation, course structure, interactivity, localization, and delivery in one place.
How is Colossyan different from traditional AI video tools?
Most AI video tools stop at video creation. Colossyan is a full platform: you create videos with AI avatars , build structured courses, add interactive elements, localize into 100+ languages, and manage everything in one workflow. There is no need to stitch together separate tools for authoring, video, translation, and delivery.
What features does Colossyan include?
The platform includes 300+ AI avatars and voiceovers, video and course creation from PDFs and presentations, interactive elements like branching scenarios and quizzes, multi-language localization , team collaboration, versioning without re-recording, and SCORM export for LMS delivery.
Is Colossyan only for video?
No. Video is the starting point, but Colossyan goes beyond that: standalone videos, interactive videos with branching and quizzes , or full training programs through Colossyan Learn . Teams use it across departments and languages without switching tools.
What kind of content can I create with Colossyan?
Most teams use it for onboarding and training videos . It also works well for compliance courses, sales enablement, internal communications, and customer education. You can create standalone videos or full structured courses with Colossyan Learn , then localize everything into 100+ languages from one workflow.
Do I need video or instructional design expertise?
No. Colossyan is built for teams without specialized production skills. You start from a document, presentation, or topic description and the platform generates the video and course structure. Pre-built templates handle the design, so you work at the knowledge level, not the technical level.
How does pricing work?
There is a free Starter tier with core creation features. Professional plans scale with video minutes and collaboration needs. Enterprise plans add governance, SSO, dedicated support, and custom avatar creation. All paid plans include access to Colossyan Learn.
